answer:
The retrieved context doesn't include the starter example itself, so this answer comes from the persistence guide. That guide says the call is `storage_context.persist()`, and the directory is `persist_dir`, defaulting to `./storage`:

"storage_context.persist(persist_dir="<persist_dir>")" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/storing/save_load.md]

"This will persist data to disk, under the specified `persist_dir` (or `./storage` by default)." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/storing/save_load.md]

So if the starter example calls `persist()` without a `persist_dir`, the index is saved to `./storage`. I can't confirm the exact call the starter example uses.
